title: Implementation Engineer
text:
At Expel, signing a new customer is just the beginning. The real magic happens when we turn that excitement into a seamless onboarding experience, working integrations, confident security teams, and a customer who's ready to get the most out of our platform.

That's where you come in.

As an Implementation Engineer, you'll own the first 30–60 days of the customer journey, taking customers from their initial sales handoff through technical implementation, enablement, and their first real value with Expel.

This isn't just about configuring tools or checking boxes. You'll be the person bringing everything together, helping customers navigate technical challenges, keeping implementations on track, and making sure they're set up for success long after onboarding is complete.

You'll work closely with customers, our Security Operations Center (SOC), Customer Success, and internal technical teams to deliver an onboarding experience that's thoughtful, efficient, and built around each customer's environment.

What Expel can do for you:

Give you ownership of the customer onboarding experience, from initial handoff through successful implementation and transition to Customer Success.

Provide opportunities to work with a variety of enterprise security environments, technologies, and customer challenges.

Connect you with experienced security practitioners across our SOC, engineering, and customer-facing teams.

Give you a voice in improving how we onboard customers, streamline processes, and deliver value faster.

Help you continue developing your technical expertise across cybersecurity, cloud environments, and Expel's Workbench platform.

Offer a remote work environment where you can collaborate across teams while taking ownership of your work.

What you can do for Expel:

Own the customer onboarding journey. Manage a portfolio of 15–20+ implementations simultaneously, guiding customers from post-sale handoff through technical setup, enablement, and initial value.

Bring customers live with confidence. Lead technical onboarding, including security integrations, configurations, Workbench training, custom setup, and incident simulations.

Help customers get the most out of Expel. Partner with our SOC to validate customer configurations and ensure they're positioned to detect and respond to real threats.

Keep implementations moving. Establish clear timelines, communicate expectations, manage milestones, and hold customers accountable while maintaining strong relationships.

Get ahead of potential issues. Identify technical blockers, customer readiness gaps, and slipping timelines early, escalating when necessary to prevent onboarding delays and future retention risks.

Make customer transitions seamless. Partner closely with Customer Success to ensure every handoff includes the technical context, customer expectations, and documentation needed for long-term success.

Help us continuously improve. Identify recurring onboarding challenges, provide feedback to Product and internal teams, and recommend improvements that reduce friction and accelerate time-to-value.

Support the broader team. Maintain accurate implementation documentation and provide technical guidance to associate-level teammates when needed.

What You Should Bring With You

2+ years of experience implementing SaaS solutions, security services, or IT services within enterprise environments.

Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Implementation Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Technical Support, or Professional Services.

Working knowledge of cybersecurity technologies, including EDR, SIEM, NDR, and CASB, and how these tools support enterprise security operations.

A solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including the OSI model, DNS, firewalls, and proxies, particularly as they relate to security integrations and deployments.

Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and their native security services.

text:
HPE Channel Private Cloud AI Presales - India & GSI

  This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:
   
Global Sales at HPE is about building the future. We are redefining what’s next and combining our legacy of innovation with a bold new goal to accelerate everything we do. Our sales organization is comprised of 10,000+ professionals in sales, presales, service, and support functions. Together with our partners, we deliver global, commercial, public sector & small/medium business customers throughout 11 geographies. We’re transforming businesses. Join us redefine what’s next for you.

Job Family Definition:
Responsible for architecting solutions that will support Partners in achieving their customers' business outcomes across the HPE Private Cloud AI portfolio (hardware, software, services, and as a service offerings) in combination with all necessary third-party components (e.g. ISV integration). Develops and articulates compelling, accurate, and relevant proposals and ensures customer's business and technical requirements are met. Can be aligned to a specific area of technical expertise (e.g., products, solutions, services). Provides technical expertise to sales teams and customers (through sales presentations, product/solution demonstrations, etc.) aimed at gaining the customer mindshare within their domain. These jobs focus on technical selling to customers/partners. May be aligned to specific accounts based on business priority.
Management Level Definition:
Contributions impact technical components of HPE products, solutions, or services regularly and sustainable. Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Provides expertise and partnership to functional and technical project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for achieving objectives. May provide team leadership and mentoring to others.

What you’ll do:

Responsibilities:
Demonstrates in-depth knowledge in one or more solution domains, company products, services, and solutions as well as the customer’s technical and business environment.
Develops compelling customer proposals and critically reviews them, manages the expectations of internal stakeholders and customers, ensuring the meeting of customer’s business and technical requirements are met.
Quantifies the impact of the business problem(s), positions business value, identifies the strengths and weaknesses of the overall proposed solution to achieve long-term business objectives.
Provides input to all global business units to address IT trends, requirements, gaps, or unmet needs.

Communicates how the solution value propositions addresses customer business needs.
Tracks leading-edge and emerging technologies.

Summary
Design, build and support enterprise integrations, agents, MCPs and API security capabilities using MuleSoft, Agent Fabric, Wallarm, and Agentforce. You will develop and support APIs, integrations, AI agents, and MCP-based connectivity while helping implement governance, security, monitoring, and platform reliability.
You will join a team that owns the enterprise integration and agent fabric platform end to end: API development and management, MuleSoft integrations, Agentforce agent development and support, Agent Fabric governance, MCP connectivity, and API security and monitoring with Wallarm.

About the Platform You'll Work On
You will be part of the team building and operating a modern enterprise Data and Integration Platform that enables secure, reliable, and scalable connectivity across applications, data platforms, APIs, and AI-powered experiences.
The platform includes technologies such as MuleSoft Anypoint Platform for API-led integration and connectivity, Agent Fabric for enabling, governing, and observing AI agents and agent-to-system interactions, and Wallarm for API discovery, monitoring, and protection.
You will have the opportunity to work across traditional APIs, event-driven integrations, data services, and emerging agentic integration patterns, including APIs and tools used by AI agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based services. You will work alongside experienced engineers to learn how enterprise integration, API management, AI connectivity, observability, and security come together as part of a shared platform.
Responsibilities
Integration and API Platform
Build and support APIs and integrations using MuleSoft.
Help develop reusable integration components and API policies.
Support connectivity between enterprise systems, data platforms, and AI applications.
Agentic Platform and Governance
Support onboarding and management of agents and MCP servers through Agent Fabric.
Help implement governance, access controls, and lifecycle management for agent integrations.
Enable secure agent-to-system connectivity using APIs and MCP-based patterns.
API Security and Observability
Help monitor API traffic and security signals using Wallarm.
Support API discovery, security policy enforcement, and investigation of anomalous behavior.
Troubleshoot API and integration issues using logs, metrics, and platform telemetry.
Reliability and Delivery
Contribute to CI/CD, automated testing, deployment automation, and platform configuration.
